question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only five people sit to the left of B. Only five people sit to the right of A. C sits to the immediate left of F but right of D. E does not sit to the right of D. How many people sit to the right of G?
solution:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

 
• Only five people sit to the left of B.
 
• Only five people sit to the right of A.
 
• C sits to the immediate left of F but right of D.
 
• E does not sit to the right of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e19034c46b1212d3aced1133d7d5906e957919084030a6d33f1a1c3c7039d81.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
